Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 15-G at 1101-1109 W

Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE                       'S'^^y          1^   |



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION I . Titie 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-5 Community Shopping

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-G in an area bound by




West Granville Avenue; North Winthrop Avenue; a line 57.76 feet south of and parallel

to West Granville Avenue; And the public alley next west of and parallel to North

Winthrop Avenue




to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 1101-09 W. Granville Ave. / 6172 N. Winthrop Ave.
                                       CITY OF CHICAGO                          O ^         ^ « ^ *^

7.    On what date did the owner acquire legal title to the subject property? January 2017

8.    Has the present owner previously rezoned this property? If Yes, when?

             Yes. October 11.2017

9.    Present Zoning District       B3-5            Proposed Zoning District       B2-3

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions?)    57.92' x 100.0'
11.   Current Use of the property 2-story mixed-use building with 8 vacant ground floor
      commercial units and 10 occupied residential dwelling units on the 2"*^ floor.

12.   Reason for rezoning the subject property: The applicant wishes to establish a qualifying
      transit-served location at the subject property in order to allow for conversion of a vacant
      ground floor commercial space into 8 residential dwelling units in the existing 2-story
      mixed use building for a new total of 18 dwelling units at the property. The applicant will
      seek relief, as necessary, for reduction in parking per applicable transit-served location
      regulations. The exterior of the existing building will remain with no changes.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
       The applicant wishes to establish a qualifying transit-served location at the subject
      property in order to allow for conversion of a vacant ground floor commercial space into
      8 residential dwelling units in the existing 2-story mixed use building, 24.0' in height, for
      a new total of 18 dwelling units at the property. The applicant will seek relief, as
      necessary, for reduction in parking per applicable transit-served location regulations. The
      exterior of the existing building will remain with no changes. There are no planned
      commercial spaces at the property. 4 on-site parking stalls and 18 bicycle parking stalls
      will be provided on-site.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or afinancialcontribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?


                     YES                            NO     X
